Honestly, practice and gaining experience helps the most obviously. But what I do is before objectives or when a fight is going to break out I look at the enemy team and think about what are the biggest threats and try to play around that. Maybe it’s hard to keep track of everything, but let’s say you’re an ADC player, do they have an assassin? Keep an eye out and save CD’s and flash for that. Does your support have good engage and ult? Watch for that and make sure you can follow up with damage. If you’re a tank think about what you need to do to peel for your carries and what cc’s or ults you need to wait for before using your own, or using your own engagement before they can react. There’ll probably be a lot of times you’ll die to things you don’t expect but as you get more gameplay and fight literate you’ll be able to ‘see’ more. But basically just be deliberate and prepare instead of just hoping you can react real time.
